text.p: The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crisis deepens in Holy Land: Netanyahu, Arafat consider meeting as fighting triggers fear of full-scale war.
- Police become part of inifada: Bullets back up stone-throwers.
- Plug excise tax leaks, Auditor-General says: Report to House of Commons outlines scams.
- Quebec Premier Lucien Bouchard dismisses bid for ruling on sovereignty: Ottawa asks Supreme Court to decide legality of secession.
- Genetic difference found in AIDS rate: Africans lack mutation, scientists say.
- Provinces fight gun registry: Alberta leads three others in challenge of federal authority.
- General Motors of Canada Ltd's letter to employees angers union: Auto firm's president makes unprecedented appeal to workers about need for outsourcing.
- Bre-X Minerals Ltd explores merger for Indonesian bonanza: May seek partner, sell share to develop massive gold claim.
- Eli Lilly Canada Inc loses Prozac court battle: Way cleared for drug companies to sell look-alike pills
- Tax credit programs bilked of millions, Auditor-General says: Goods and Savings Tax, child tax called ripe for fraud.

- Manulife Financial wants Altamira Management Ltd: Canada's biggest insurer is set to bid for the 70 percent of the mutual fund it doesn't already own. But bad blood over a botched offer for Altamira by TD Bank could kill the deal.
- Bre-X offers to sell big stake in its Busang gold project.
